prompt:
One single image: an EXACT grid of 3 columns and 2 rows — exactly 6 equal square tiles, separated by thin pure-white gutters, with a thin pure-white outer border. Every tile is its own polished illustration in modern Korean webtoon (manhwa) style: clean crisp digital lineart, soft cel shading with smooth gradients, bright fresh colors, attractive expressive characters with large clear eyes, clean simple backgrounds with soft depth; one clear central subject, fully inside the tile with comfortable margin around heads and feet; consistent character design and style across all tiles. Strictly NO text of any kind anywhere: no speech bubbles, no captions, no labels, no letters, numbers, signs, kanji or writing.
Tile contents in reading order (left to right, top row first):
1. Overwhelmed office worker surrounded by a whole month's piled tasks.
2. Faded memory scene of a rainy street from a couple of days ago.
3. Packed suitcase waiting by the door for a trip the day after tomorrow.
4. Two friends of the same age blowing out birthday candles together.
5. Bright full moon above a pagoda in the night sky.
6. Relaxing day off, person lounging on tatami with a cup of tea.
